findings.title: Service shares host namespaces
findings.description: network_mode: host (or pid: host) drops network/process isolation: the service sees host interfaces and processes, bypassing network policies. Use explicit port publishing and keep the default namespaces.

evidence.expected: published ports on the default bridge network

findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: Service runs as root
findings.description: Without a user: directive the service runs as root; a container breakout then yields host root. Run as a non-root UID/GID.
findings.remediation: Enable MFA on the account and restrict root usage. Create individual IAM users or federate via SSO, attach least-privilege policies, and never use root for daily operations.
